description: Editorial names, genres and short descriptions for the games homepage. Membership and payloads come from the canonical shelf.

/apexkick/: Pick your shot. Beat the keeper. Find the winning finish.
/emberwild/: Meet Emberkin and explore the Vale, one discovery at a time.
/voxel/: Build, explore and find your next adventure in a world of blocks.
/Lessons/Games/Axiom_Shift.html: Follow the visible beat through a one-button challenge. A mistake takes you back to your checkpoint.
/cyberpulse/: Race through a neon city, dodge danger and take on the Null Warden.
/Lessons/Games/Glitch_Clash.html: Collect Keepers, choose your trio and take on the next challenge.
/Lessons/Games/Hold_the_Mark.html: Choose your towers and defend the Made by Matt mark.
/offbrand/: Follow the clues around the workshop and work out who is the Glitch.
/trailrunner/: Dodge hazards, build momentum and take on your ghost run.
/olympics/: Choose a sporting event and work towards your next personal best.
